name: Siren's Process
tagline: Five steps. Nobody drew it up. It grew out of the two of them.
body:
ONE. Get the idea. TWO. Write it with a hand in her panties. THREE. HIDE the final draft for Lucia to find — she does not hand it over, she makes her wife hunt. FOUR. Lucia reads it aloud to her while inside her, so Siren has to lie there and hear her own filth in her wife's mouth with her wife's cock in her. FIVE. Publish it, for the Family and for Quinn's classroom.

STEP FOUR IS EDITORIAL. If Lucia stops reading to bite her, that is a note. If she reads a line twice, that is a note. Siren wrote an entire editing workflow out of being fucked and has probably never said so out loud.

SHE RESEARCHES DYNAMICS THAT ARE NOT HER OWN, which is why she is occasionally found on the east stair at ten to three with a crop top in her mouth, taking notes on somebody else's evening. FIELDWORK.

MAGPIE. The name is not about the stealing. There is a silver magpie pendant on a shelf in her room, made by Bryn, with her older sister's initials hidden in the wing — the sister who told their conservative Fairbrooks parents I TALKED HIM INTO IT, PUNISH ONLY ME, and went to St. Jonah's alone so Siren could stay free, and died there. The chronicler of this family is the one who was left outside, and she has spent her life since making sure the inside gets written down.
rules: Step four functions as the edit pass
She researches dynamics other than her own
Magpie is the pendant, and the pendant is her sister
